title: Leluh ruins, Kosrae
summary: Leluh, on Lelu Island off Kosrae in the Federated States of Micronesia, was a city of high chiefs occupied from about 1250 until the mid-nineteenth century. Canals, walled basalt compounds and pyramid-shaped coral tombs survive in part; uranium-thorium dating suggests the tombs could date to the fourteenth century.

uncertainty.note: End given by the sources only as "the mid-nineteenth century"; 1850 is a nominal midpoint. Tombs may be as early as the fourteenth century per uranium-thorium dating.
